description: Ex-JASDF F-104J displayed indoors; the Chinese Wikipedia survivor table states the number painted on it is WRONG (機號誤植為4303); the true identity is 4522; note that the number 4303 also appeared wrongly on the Jiji park F-104J until 2016 and that the number 4522 was wrongly painted on the Chenggongling F-104J; the ROCAF F-104J display fleet has a systemic mis-marking problem
museum_name: National Science and Technology Museum F-104 -- Kaohsiung
